status_corrections.actual_source_outcome: At M=1 the Definition uses the sole root1, folds coefficients modulo z-1 and needs no primitive-root reindexing. The separate n=0 branch returns the zero vector before any product tree; positive pole lists use the explicit collision test before quotient evaluation.

The full state and rank dimensions are N,r>=1 and filter length is L>=1, but the nonexceptional pole partition may be empty when every lambda_j=-2/Delta. Its Cauchy sum is then zero by the called n=0 procedure, and the finite exceptional constant term supplies the value. Empty J or Z coordinate partitions are handled by their stated diagonal/bordered branches, not by setting the whole state dimension to zero.

The initial h_0 and c_0 are supplied independently. At t=1 each gate uses h_0 and the cell update uses c_0; the recurrence is asserted only for t>=1, so it does not impose the updated-state identity on arbitrary initial h_0,c_0.

The unrolling starts with the supplied h_0 and uses inputs x_1 through x_T, with each evaluation at t using the preceding state. No evaluation at an input x_0 or x_{T+1} is required; at zero horizon there are no map-evaluation occurrences beyond the initial state.

N,r,L and the root-grid length M are positive, but either diagonal index partition lambda_j=-a or lambda_j!= -a may be empty. Proof step 1.2 handles the exceptional constants and step 4.1 uses the n=0 Cauchy procedure for an empty nonexceptional sum; the scaled-resolvent identity remains valid termwise.
